data.body_html:
Combine the glamour of Starlite 2031 with a Marbella yacht charter for a pre-concert experience that turns a night out into a full evening of luxury. Depart Puerto Banús at 7pm, cruise the Golden Mile as the sun sets behind La Concha, and anchor 500 metres from the Starlite Auditorium. A tender whisks you to the venue in 5 minutes — no traffic, no queues. Post-concert, return to your private deck for a nightcap under the stars. Here's how to plan it.

Why a Pre-Concert Yacht Charter Works for Starlite

Starlite Marbella draws A-list acts every summer, but the real magic starts on the water. A 2-hour cruise from Puerto Banús at 7pm lets you watch the coast turn gold, sip cava, and arrive at the venue relaxed and on time. Our Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) or Azimut 39 (€749/2h) are perfect for couples or small groups. For larger parties, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) includes a jet ski and space for 12 guests. All departures are from Puerto Banús, just 15 minutes from the Starlite site.

Best Boats for Starlite 2031

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) — €749/2h, ideal for a couple or small group.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) — €749/2h, spacious and stylish.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) — €4,719/4h, includes a jet ski and premium space.
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) — pricing on request, perfect for a party.

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. No hidden extras.

Sample Timetable: Pre-Concert Cruise

TimeActivity
19:00Depart Puerto Banús, cruise east along the Golden Mile.
20:00Anchor 500m from Starlite Auditorium; enjoy drinks and snacks.
20:45Tender transfer to venue (5 minutes).
21:00Concert starts.
23:00Tender picks you up; return to boat for a nightcap.
00:00Cruise back to Puerto Banús.

What's Included in Your Charter

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% Spanish IVA. You can also order a catered dinner from local Marbella restaurants — contact us via WhatsApp to arrange it. For a full list of our fleet, see our Marbella yacht charter page.

Tips for a Smooth Starlite Evening

  • Book your boat 2-4 weeks ahead — Starlite sells out fast.
  • Dress for the evening: light layers for the sea breeze, smart-casual for the venue.
  • Bring a small bag for the tender; stilettos and sand don't mix.
  • Arrive at Puerto Banús 15 minutes before departure for boarding.
  • Consider a full-day charter (8 hours) to explore Cabopino or Estepona before the concert.

Frequently Asked Questions

What time should we depart for a Starlite concert?

Depart Puerto Banús at 7pm for a 2-hour cruise along the Marbella coastline. This gives you time to enjoy sunset views of La Concha and anchor near the Starlite venue by 9pm, with a 5-minute tender transfer to the auditorium.

Which boat is best for a Starlite pre-concert cruise?

For couples or small groups, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 at €749/2h are ideal. For larger parties up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) offers space and a jet ski. All depart from Puerto Banús.

Can we eat dinner on the boat before the concert?

Yes. We provide light snacks and drinks, but you can order a catered dinner from local Marbella restaurants for an extra fee. Contact us via WhatsApp to arrange a menu.

How do we get from the boat to the Starlite venue?

We anchor 500m from the Starlite Auditorium. Our tender boat transfers you directly to the venue's dock in about 5 minutes. No long walks or traffic.

What happens after the concert ends?

The tender will be waiting to bring you back to your charter boat. Enjoy a nightcap on deck while the crowd disperses, then cruise back to Puerto Banús at your leisure.

Is the charter price all-inclusive?

Yes. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% Spanish IVA. No hidden costs.

Do we need to book for Starlite 2031 far in advance?

Yes, Starlite concerts sell out quickly, and so do our boats. Book at least 2-4 weeks ahead via WhatsApp to secure your preferred vessel and departure time.

Can we extend the charter to include the next day?

Absolutely. Many guests choose a full-day charter (8 hours) that includes the pre-concert cruise and a post-concert return. Contact us for pricing on longer durations.
